# Vendored TLSNotary

Source: https://github.com/tlsnotary/tlsn tag `v0.1.0-alpha.15` (commit 47aee45b53e06648c1b2ad3689b367b8c923fdec).
License: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE files / upstream README).

Used via `[patch."https://github.com/tlsnotary/tlsn"]` in the zkfetch root `Cargo.toml`.
zkfetch changes on top of upstream are listed in `ZKFETCH_PATCHES.md` and are intended
to be upstreamed (tlsn #859 / #978 / #1001).
